description: Recent trades opened through TradeHub with entry, stop, take-profit, leverage and realised profit or loss. Third-party apps see only the trades they opened; the user's own keys and Telegram see all. Use for reviews and reports. Not for live positions (use get_my_open_positions). Input: limit (1-200), closed_since, before (pages: pass next_before back until it is null). Sizes in the base coin, money in USD. Next: get_my_open_positions.

before.description: Next page: the next_before of the previous answer
before.title: Before

closed_since.description: Only trades closed at or after this time (ISO 8601); open trades are left out
closed_since.title: Closed Since
